page.overview:
What is Watchplains?

The Watchplains is a dungeon located in the Cornelia Region of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy, accessible by climbing up the hill with outposts in the northwest. It is the main setting of Chapter 4, "A Legendary Warrior".

;Backroad 1 Contains a Gate near the dungeon's exit back out to the Cornelia Region.

;Backroad 3 The player traverses through a canyon, underneath a bridge, and up flights of stairs to the top. Further on the path, the player crosses the bridge, then another with a Save Crystal at the other side. The path eventually leads to the levels below through several stairways. At the end of this area is a boss fight with a Giant Goblin and a Bahamutian Commander. An Exit Gate appears here after defeating them.

To the left of the Exit Gate is a stairway that leads down to the Secret Backroad.
